purpose: Frozen Week 8 main-model-v1 benchmark. Single authorized route from Week 7 (Route B: Static Directed Query/Key dual-space with a simple context adapter first; DeepSets NOT enabled). Reuses the exact nine dataset content pins and split contract from the completed Week 6 full experiment. Student distills teacher true-class beta (beta-KL first) plus raw-score ranking (second). No dataset may be added, removed, or replaced after inspecting any Week 8 readout. Hyperparameters and the descriptive completion gate were frozen before any Week 8 Teacher fit.

preprocessing.feature_policy: numeric-only float64; reject non-finite values; no imputation, feature selection, or target-derived transform
preprocessing.label_policy: encode observed target labels deterministically after loading; support labels may enter Teacher contexts; query labels never enter a Teacher fit
preprocessing.sample_id_policy: source row index is retained as dataset_id:row:<index>

split.selection: deterministic stratified holdout without replacement; query rows are first sampled from the 20 percent holdout, and support rows are sampled only from the remaining train pool

student.route: Route B: Static Directed with simple context adapter first (Week 7 authorization)
student.backbone: numerical standardized MLP (support-only mean/variance; queries reuse frozen support statistics); hidden 128, h 128 (plan Section 8)
student.score: s_ij = q_i . k_j / sqrt(64); no q/k normalization in v1
student.standardization: standardize with pseudo-support mean/variance only; pseudo-queries, full support and holdout queries reuse those frozen statistics
student.train_device_rationale: training sets are tiny (at most 64 pseudo-queries); CPU training is fast and deterministic with fixed seeds, while the Teacher still runs on CUDA
student.pseudo_query_selection: label-blind seeded choice without replacement from frozen support order, sorted back into support order

adapter.context_vector: c = mean of support h over the scored support set
adapter.deep_sets_note: DeepSets context encoder stays disabled until the adapter is shown insufficient (Week 7 hand-off; Week 12 robustness at the earliest)

losses.primary: beta-KL: KL(teacher true-class beta || softmax(student true-class scores)) averaged over train pseudo-queries
losses.secondary: pairwise logistic ranking on teacher mean raw scores (true-class block): mean softplus(-sign(dt)*ds) over pairs with |dt| > epsilon
losses.total: KL + 0.5 * ranking; frozen for v1, ablated in Week 9
losses.train_label_use: train pseudo-query labels select the true-class block only (analogous to SupCon positives); frozen holdout query labels never enter training

supcon_baseline.purpose: matched-budget symmetric baseline: same optimizer/epochs/learning-rate/seed budget and same 64-dim output width; backbone width matched at 128; heads differ by design (symmetric cosine vs directed Q/K), so this is budget-matched, not weight-identical
supcon_baseline.standardization: standardize with support mean and variance only; query rows use the frozen support statistics
supcon_baseline.positives: same-class in-batch samples without input augmentation; anchors without a positive are excluded from the loss

evaluation.teacher_target_for_eval: eval-fit true-class beta block and eval-fit mean raw true-class block
metrics: spearman(student scores, teacher beta) per query
label top-1/top-5 hit rate over full support (labels for metric only)
evaluation.global_summary: mean over the nine frozen datasets (descriptive only)
evaluation.leakage_boundary: student training sees pseudo-support/pseudo-query features and train-split labels only; every eval Teacher fit receives support features, support labels, and holdout query features alone; holdout query labels are released only for metric computation

gate.rule: technical PASS requires every frozen dataset/seed executed, finite metrics, recomputable profiles, and intact provenance; the gate makes no route claim and moves no threshold
gate.recommendation: STUDENT_V1_COMPLETE Proceed to Week 9 target/loss/dimension ablations
